name: Masquerade Kiss ~Kiken na Kakehiki~
original_name: マスカレード・キス～危険な駆け引き～
source:
“Your name and your job are all lies, but this love is real.”

You are a gifted “special” agent and your special skill is acting as any kind of woman possible. But your policy is to never “give your body” whatever mission you take. 

In your private life, you are a carb lover. binges on foreign drama, Tom Cruise fan, can’t give up ice cream late at night and secretly adores your boss. What will happen when you crush on one of your targets?
translation:
“你的名字和你的工作都是谎言，但这份爱是真实的。”

你是一位有天赋的“特殊”特工，你的特殊技能是尽可能扮演任何类型的女人。但你的政策是永远不要“放弃你的身体”，无论你承担什么使命。

在你的私人生活中，你是碳水化合物爱好者。狂看洋剧，汤姆·克鲁斯迷，深夜离不开冰淇淋，暗恋你的老板。当你暗恋某个目标时会发生什么？
